209902: Matsumoto is an AI that came to Vivy from 100 years into the future. Its mission as an AI is "to avoid the war between AI and humankind." To that end, its goal is to destroy AI with Vivy. It is talkative, overconfident, and has a personality that is not like an AI.
209903: Vivy is the first autonomous humanoid AI in history. Her mission as an AI is to make everyone happy with her songs, thus she aims to sing with all her heart. She attaches great importance to promises and feelings, and is an AI "diva" that serves humankind.
215276: Estella is an AI staff working at the space hotel "Sunrise" outside the atmosphere. Her mission as an AI is "to take care of human beings as a life keeper." She is polite, tolerant, and friendly.
215277: Grace is an AI nurse who works in hospitals and research institutes. Her mission as an AI is "to save human life as an AI nurse." She is an angel in a white coat who always smiles and speaks in a polite tone so as to give the patient a peace of mind.
215278: Ophelia is a diva AI active in small theaters around the world. Her mission as an AI is "to make everyone happy with songs" like Vivy. She's usually a bit shy and sloppy, but she performs the highlight on stage.
216423: Momoka was helped by Diva once when she got lost in NiaLand, since then she has grown attached to her and deeply cares about her she gave her nickname Vivy (ヴィヴィ).
216424: An AI researcher who sends “Matsumoto” one hundred years back in time to change history. He is the one who developed the AI for Matsumoto and is one of the world’s leading experts in his field.
216425: An assemblyman who is working to pass the AI Naming Law, which would grant human rights to AIs. He is friendly but has no notable achievements to his name.
216426: The navigation system used by the employees of NiaLand. It has a foul mouth and speaks harshly to Vivy.
216437: A member of the anti-AI terrorist group, "Toak". From a young age, he's been actively promoting Toak to the the public. Vivy encounters him during her missions.
217728: An AI working at the space hotel "Sunrise". A long-time colleague of Estella's, she's a talkative person. (Official Site, translated)
218484: Estella's twin sister. She was created alongside Estella, but was discarded after an experiment. She was later picked up by the anti-AI organization Toak, where she obtained combat skills. Compared to Estella, her personality is very aggressive.
220599: A civil engineering AI that operates on the unmanned offshore plant, Metal Float. Its mission as an AI is to "contribute to the development of the Metal Float for the benefit of humanity." It shares the same build as several other AI on the island. (Official Site, translated)
225837: Ophelia's partner AI. Their mission is to support Ophelia as a Soundmaster AI. Their words can be harsh but they recognizes Ophelia's talent as a singer.
231664: The granddaughter of Yuugo Kakitani and a member of Toak. She is the leader of the moderate group that hopes to coexist with AI.
